Travel guide

Plan smarter trips across Europe.

These guides help you balance cost, timing, local transport, and destination choices so your itinerary feels efficient and enjoyable.

Choose a city strategically

  • Pick destinations with direct transport links.
  • Keep your route compact and realistic.
  • Reserve central neighborhoods for less commute time.

Travel on a budget

  • Book flights and trains early to secure better rates.
  • Use local transit and avoid high taxi costs.
  • Focus on one anchor city and one nearby day trip.

Prepare before you go

  • Download maps and offline travel data.
  • Check visa, health, and insurance requirements.
  • Set up eSIM and mobile backup before departure.
Popular routes
  • Rome + Florence
  • Paris + Brussels
  • Barcelona + Lisbon
  • Amsterdam + Berlin
